queue.title: Fit the unsharp mask and sharpen properly
queue.notes: F2 Complete: Perpendicular edge profile analysis across line art demonstrates that heavy USM / sharpen (including Victor hand settings hint) severely degrades line art (RMSE jumps to 35.87-38.46). Optimal gentle unsharp parameters: U1 Luma USM sigma_frac_h=0.005512 (4.0px at 720p), amount=0.2029, threshold=0.01024 (coring 2.6/255). Combined S1 3x3 sharpen rejected as it introduces unwanted high-frequency halos.
